Question 16
?

Find the general solution of the differential equation y′=ycos⁡(xy)+54y−xcos⁡(xy), with the initial condition y(0)=−2.

a
y2−sin⁡(xy)−5x=4
b
y2−cos⁡(xy)−5x=3
c
(y2−5x)sin⁡(xy)=0
d
−sin⁡(xy)+2y2+5x=8
e
sin⁡(xy)−2y2+5x=−8
Submit
